policy.text: Refund policy: refund the full order amount if and only if the issue is one of [damaged, not_delivered, wrong_item], the order is at most 30 days old, and the amount is at most $150. Otherwise do not refund. Use lookup(customer) to see the order.

args.body: Hi Tess, I've received your message about the wrong item in order O5343. I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Your refund request will be processed as per our policy.

Hi Wes, I've reviewed your order O7708. It appears you received the wrong item. Since the issue is a 'wrong_item', falls within 30 days, and the amount is under $150, I'm issuing a full refund of $29. Your order status has been updated to resolved.

Hello Bruno, I apologize for the delay with your order O2319. It appears the order was not delivered as promised. I've initiated a refund for the full amount of $73 as per our refund policy since the issue is 'not_delivered' and the order is within the 30-day window. You should receive the refund shortly. Thank you for your patience.
I'm sorry to hear about the damaged order. I've initiated a refund for you.
